اعتكفوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَكَفُوا (iʕtakafū) /iʕ.ta.ka.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# اِعْتَكِفُوا (iʕtakifū) /iʕ.ta.ki.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
